audience_job.job: Choose a supported mode without unsafe or inflated expectations

recommendations.problem: Current docs contain an overbroad database no-change guarantee, a team-server network statement that omits databases, and notebook/global-filter scope that is easy to overgeneralize; intent briefs contradict shipped source. The docs-home promise of a live try on every page also exceeds the four priority pages' actual example wiring.
recommendations.proposal: Correct the two absolute claims; say database reads use driver-specific safeguards and require least-privileged credentials. Name database egress alongside author-requested downloads. Scope local-browser privacy and notebook chart selections. Add current-status pointers to stale intent briefs without erasing their history.

cost.bounded_scope: Focused edits to priority docs and three intent status notes; no security redesign.
cost.estimate_basis: Editorial/implementation scope estimate, not a delivery-time promise.

recommendations.benefit: Removes misleading expectations before increasing feature prominence.
recommendations.alternative: Hide database/self-hosting capabilities until a full security audit; disproportionate, but retain uncertainty and require operational proof before stronger guarantees.

confidence.reason: Text/code contradictions are direct observations; safeguard adequacy is not certified.

acceptance_checks: No universal no-write/no-network/no-upload claim remains without an explicit runtime/component scope.

Managed hosting, built-in SSO, warehouse connectors and arbitrary notebook kernels are not advertised as shipped.
